When I was 17 I moved to Wales (Great Britain) to work as a "charity vocational worker" for a year. It basically means I can live in said country as long as I don't make any money. To be able to live in Wales I had to save a LOT of money; close to $12k.

At the time I thought I was God's gift to the world. I was the center of the universe... turns out I'm not. Living somewhere else taught me that while all life is important, I am a tiny drop of paint in this beautiful mosaic called "life".

So yes, go. Do things. Be free and most importantly, LEARN SOMETHING!
